_comment: Ground truth from the design team for screen-identity splitting. Each entry: board file (in ~/Downloads or wherever the export lives), two frame node ids, and whether they are the SAME screen. Used by identity_audit.py --check-labels as the regression gate for screen_identity.split_frames.

labels.note: 11011 shows a dialog overlay; 10950 is the plain host creation Landing — design team call
member join Landing vs host creation Landing — design team call
same screen, elements are the same — design team call
two different dialog overlays, elements differ — design team call
same MPS, same elements — design team call
slightly different, one extra button below — design team call: same screen
OTP entry empty vs filled — state variant, not a second screen
